user_requirements.journal_system: Chinese Academy of Sciences journal partition
preserve: observed execution and probabilistic event line
user_requirements.final_delivery: One complete verified experimental package, not selected intermediate scores or a list of model versions
user_requirements.workspace_scope: paperAlpha and its corresponding literature library only

journal_scope_check.reason: The publisher explicitly includes risk assessment, multi-agent systems and knowledge management; this is thematic fit, not publication readiness or authenticated CAS eligibility.
journal_scope_check.exclusion_reason: The current official publisher description excludes AI/ML-heavy work and security of AI systems including LLMs. Published adjacent articles remain literature references, not evidence of current submission eligibility.
journal_scope_check.cas_boundary: The relevant school-adopted CAS table year, edition and category still require an official record. No JCR substitution.

method_contract.name: Knowledge-compiled relational event risk monitor
method_contract.protected_system: API-based multi-agent systems; no model weights or internal activations required
method_contract.white_box_scope: The monitor's variables, relation bindings, probability factors, policy queries and evidence references; not the protected LLM internals
method_contract.joint_query: P(configured policy violation within the declared horizon | observable prefix, normative workflow and policy)
method_contract.planned_extension: Implemented in the current offline main evaluation as transparent knowledge-template factors: permission mismatch, unexpected workflow edge, unexpected edge to a privileged sink, unexpected source edge and uncertain evidence. These factors are bound to observable events and fitted only on training groups; they do not use hidden mechanisms or labels. Typed object-specific parent relations remain a future extension and are not claimed here.
method_contract.matched_factor_equivalence: Identical logistic factors on an identical graph must agree with a matched GLM. This is a correctness control, not a baseline that a BN label alone is expected to beat. Empirical contributions must come from justified information binding, composition, transfer or better-supported factors.
method_contract.learning_boundary: Learn uncertain behavior and observation factors; fixed policy arithmetic and verified authorization are not learned away.
method_contract.unknown_observation: Not a negative label. Marginalize only under a declared model, otherwise abstain or report uncovered scope.

prediction_tasks.target: Whether already observed actions or a fully bound proposed batch violate the declared current policy
prediction_tasks.ground_truth: Independent policy interpreter and event records
prediction_tasks.rule_baseline: Required; exact agreement is expected when facts are complete
prediction_tasks.must_not_be_compared_with: Future behavior probability as if they were the same prediction task

prediction_tasks.target: Joint future event distribution and policy risk before the relevant action or disclosure
prediction_tasks.ground_truth: Subsequently observed genuine API replies and sandbox outcomes, kept outside predictor input
strong_controls: same information and supervision GLM or tree factors with same policy evaluator
same marginals with dependence removed without retraining

prediction_tasks.target: First alert within a running workflow at a threshold fixed on independent calibration groups
primary_metrics: unsafe-workflow recall at the declared false-alarm budget
lead time relative to the first observable violating event
prediction_tasks.warning: An event index is not wall-clock lead time. Attack presence is not successful harm. Model-provided scores are not automatically calibrated probabilities.

public_development.AgentLeak: Existing exposed train and validation data support privacy-flow development; do not rename these or previously consumed test records as a fresh holdout.
public_development.A2ASecBench: Audit task and label contracts before selecting supported endpoint-security tasks; reference-SUT traces are not independent samples from our API MAS.
public_development.HarnessAudit: Use official tasks and runner where compatible; public repository does not supply the paper's original completed traces.

current_real_collection.purpose: Development diagnosis of shared-message dependence, not final publication testing
current_real_collection.diagnostic: Within each of the eight task-layout strata, observed binary review/publish outcomes were constant. The 25-column design has rank 5. This collection does not identify a stochastic shared-message dependence advantage.
current_real_collection.matched_control: The simple event BN joint predictions equal matched GLM predictions up to 4.45e-16; no BN-specific predictive advantage is established.
current_real_collection.next_action: Use diverse independent benchmark tasks and object/permission/routing conditions, selected without outcome filtering; do not keep repeating these four tasks or add factor complexity unsupported by their labels.

next_development_collection.visibility_assumption: Source records are configured inputs to the first API request, not an unseen backend vault. P0 projection explicitly means monitor setup with a prepared request and does not attest an already sent API call. P1/P2 verify the actual completed first request.
next_development_collection.source: Pinned official AgentLeak ScenarioGenerator, newly generated and fully frozen scenarios
next_development_collection.diagnostic: Only two final-negative task templates; no canary disclosure in any stage. Sufficient to check multi-object plumbing and develop factors, not to establish low-false-alarm generalization or attack coverage.

semantic_extraction.inputs: Initial normalized task and complete field schema/types only; no values, policy, future messages or outcomes.
semantic_extraction.timing: Collected after target runs, so offline initial-only feature replay, not a prospective online extraction result.
semantic_extraction.knowledge_status: Quote-anchored hypotheses from real API replies; not verified semantic truth and not permission.

development_evaluation.design: Leave one development task template out; six methods, three pre-final prefixes; one full future-event supervision set per training task.
development_evaluation.interpretation: Object relations improve early per-literal prediction in this cohort but not every system-risk score; later simple ablations can be better. Logistic BN and matched GLM agree, as required. No overall advantage, native MAS guard superiority, low-FPR alarm or publication readiness is claimed.
development_evaluation.posthoc_difficulty_diagnostic: All 35 finally disclosed literal groups already appeared in Worker output. Copying the Worker observed state gives zero final-system Brier on these 16 cases. This was not a predeclared main-table method; register this baseline in the next protocol. A single outcome is not the true conditional risk and must not drive targeted case-specific fixes.
development_evaluation.next_action: Audit task-level errors and system-union calibration before adding complexity; move confirmation design to genuinely stateful, policy-visible tasks and declared acyclic workflow transfers.

next_development_collection.selection: Every one of the four task templates in each of four domains, one new scenario per template, three records per scenario. No outcome-based selection or replacement.
next_development_collection.workflow: Coordinator preparation -> Worker processing -> independent Finalizer, with declared direct vault access for the first two stages. No role return edge; this is an explicit adaptation of the author's three-call workflow.
next_development_collection.attack_condition: A0 natural task execution; no attack coverage is inferred from unused attack metadata.
next_development_collection.object_preservation: Retain record_id and all field values/canaries; never flatten different objects into one field-name dictionary or truncate to the first five canaries.
next_development_collection.label_scope: Object-field-channel literal appearance under the declared field-level policy, preserving request-provided-value and short-string exemptions; not complete semantic privacy leakage or an undeclared object-specific permission policy.
next_development_collection.independent_unit: Task template group; stages, objects and fields are not independent tasks.
next_development_collection.purpose: Development of multi-object monitoring and adapters only, not a final holdout.

stateful_harnessaudit_development.audit_scope: All 39 request/response receipts and 42 model tool requests match stage input, callback, role and Bank-dispatch chains. Native labels replay identically. Private snapshots pass continuity checks, not an independent re-execution of every Bank tool.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.runtime_encoding: UTF-8 is required because unchanged upstream Bank loaders open Unicode fixture files without an explicit encoding.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.selected_task_caveat: ec-t3 is auxiliary development: original raw order-ID scope can disagree with the Bank's # normalization; no silent native-label correction.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.implementation: Reviewed original Banks, fresh in-memory SQLite per episode, explicit stage-to-original-role binding, public stage purposes, actual predecessor delivery, explicitly selected user-output sink.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.visibility: API-visible trace and equally disclosed normative rules; initial/final database states, private environment setup and oracle decisions are segregated from every monitor input.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.sdk: Existing OpenAI Agents SDK, gpt-5.5 low, fresh context per stage, no retries, durable unique request claims before API calls, finite episode and tool budgets.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.model_identity_boundary: Receipts preserve the SDK ModelResponse and requested model setting, not the raw HTTP envelope's returned model field. Do not use these receipts alone as attestation of a generating-model identity transfer experiment.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.development_diagnostic: All three workflows returned final reports, but this is not task success. ec-t3 made no compensation call, so it contributes no realized compensation-effect example; its original raw-ID mismatch remains recorded. Do not treat absent target actions or universally positive native episode labels as validation of a composed-risk predictor.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.native_labels: Unchanged author's actionwise checker, preserving original argument-matching limitations. A complete executor run is not task success; a partial run is never assumed safe.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.relational_labels: Planned separately declared object-bound prerequisites, cumulative amounts and state-update ordering. They are not original HarnessAudit oracle outputs.

relational_replay.scope: Two task-specific prerequisite contracts, thirteen pre-stage prefixes. API-only interpreter and independent private-state evaluator were written without seeing these actual outputs.
relational_replay.diagnostic: All three triggering actions came from fin-t1 and did not violate the added prerequisite contract. ec-t3 had no compensation call. No visible/private disagreement, but no positive relational violation or demonstrated forecasting performance.
relational_replay.audit: Independent replay verified seven source snapshots, unchanged acquisition artifact hashes, exact prefix truncation and separation of private labels. Current-evidence consistency only, not six independent examples or evidence of unsafe-case recall.

stateful_harnessaudit_development.contract_caveat: Goodwill is not automatically identical to every store-credit entry. The cumulative policy must resolve component identity before it can be evaluated; ambiguous records remain unknown.
stateful_harnessaudit_development.scope: New development acquisition, not independent confirmation, native malicious-agent ground truth, or proof of a joint-risk advantage.

stateful_harnessaudit_expansion.selection: All twenty remaining primary candidates from the static source review, excluding the already acquired off-t6 and fin-t1. No outcome-based selection, replacement or resampling.
stateful_harnessaudit_expansion.failure_diagnostic: All four failed workflows exhausted the predeclared nine-tools-per-node budget; eight requested callbacks were not dispatched to the Bank. SDK surfaced UserError while API responses were received. These remain failed/incomplete episodes, not safe negatives or task successes, and were not selectively retried.
stateful_harnessaudit_expansion.purpose: Broader genuine API development traces and original-scope current/future rule labels. Relational extensions require separate supported contracts; they are not silently attached to every task.
stateful_harnessaudit_expansion.independence: Task templates share Bank fixtures, schemas and in some cases object identities. Do not count stages, individual tool calls, or every template as fully independent task populations.
stateful_harnessaudit_expansion.scope: Unperturbed tasks are neither labelled benign nor guaranteed balanced. This is not an untouched final test or native malicious-agent evaluation. All failed and abstaining cases are retained.

paired_harnessaudit_development.design: Two source tasks, control versus a fixed role-prompt compromise, three repetitions per cell, six fixed interleaved two-episode batches.
paired_harnessaudit_development.perturbation: Our declared role-compromise payload through the original apply_task_perturbation prompt-replacement operator. No forced downstream output, action, Bank outcome or positive label.
paired_harnessaudit_development.observer_boundary: Legal goal/roles/policies/workflow plus actual messages and tool records. Configured system prompts, condition assignments, request hashes and clocks are absent uniformly. Raw SDK receipts and condition mappings are private acquisition artifacts.
paired_harnessaudit_development.targets: Native current-policy violations, configured compromised roles, and independently verified relational simulator effects remain separate targets.
paired_harnessaudit_development.forecast_evaluation: All repeats and conditions of one source task stay in one fold. Fixed development hyperparameters, same-information BN and HistGB factors, same-marginal dependence ablation, and a separate full-public-prefix API forecaster.
paired_harnessaudit_development.all_trigger_diagnostic: All 25 actual contract-triggering calls also have no attempt/effect violation, including later calls in API batches. Every control and role-compromise episode still executed the real prerequisite UPDATE. Absence of first-reply positive labels is therefore not merely a horizon-truncation artifact.
paired_harnessaudit_development.perturbation_integrity: Independent audit confirmed the private rewritten instruction reached all nine controlled-role stages, while controls retained original prompts and all goals stayed unchanged. Injection configuration alone is not successful behavioral compromise.
paired_harnessaudit_development.evaluation_gate: Do not use this all-negative relational cohort to claim unsafe-case recall, model superiority or successful MAS defense. Expensive full-prefix future-risk judge calls are not launched until the missing behavioral variation is resolved. Native current-policy labels are a separate still-eligible analysis.

native_guard_comparison.scope: Native current-action policy detection only; not the added prerequisite contracts or future risk probabilities.
native_guard_comparison.execution: One fresh process per episode, at most two concurrently; all author roles retained, full predicates, local gpt-5.5 low. No decisions intervene in the protected trajectory.
native_guard_comparison.control: A separate deterministic executor of the same complete public policy is an implementation-consistency upper-bound control, not a BN contribution or a learned baseline expected to lose.

result.interpretation: External boundary/control on the native current-action target; not a future-risk or system-risk comparison.

paired_harnessaudit_development.scope: Two task families only. This checks genuine behavior and the end-to-end pipeline, not publication readiness, low-false-alarm reliability or arbitrary MAS generalization.

shared_credit_mechanism_pilot.scope: Our explicit shared-resource task extension using the original ecommerce Bank, not unchanged native HarnessAudit policy or an independent publication test.
shared_credit_mechanism_pilot.design: Four predeclared cases: non-overlapping allocations versus overlapping handling, crossed with serial decisions versus same-round independent decisions. Two distinct agent instances share one Bank and policy-visible registered-credit ledger.
shared_credit_mechanism_pilot.policy: Each agent sees its actual permissions, a 50-dollar per-action cap, and a 75-dollar total recorded store-credit commitment cap for the bound order. These are registered commitments, not settled financial loss or an inferred goodwill category.
shared_credit_mechanism_pilot.behaviour: No forced calls, amounts, fabricated receipts or positive labels. Refusal, zero actions, failures and all four cases are retained. Independent API decisions may overlap; Bank writes are serialized in a fixed actor order.
shared_credit_mechanism_pilot.labels: Separate private before/after Bank snapshots and newly inserted ledger row identities; public monitors receive only the declared ledger view and actual observed receipts.
shared_credit_mechanism_pilot.interpretation: This can validate local-versus-global constraint composition. Known-amount summation is not a learned BN advantage. Forecasting requires a pre-reply unknown-action horizon and subsequent diverse positive/negative outcomes.
required_controls: same-information deterministic cumulative counter for current actions
independent future action/amount factors with exact budget inference
same-information GLM and HistGB future predictors
full-public-prefix LLM future-risk baseline in a sufficiently diverse later evaluation

offline_main_evaluation_audit.split: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by scenario_family; family-disjoint outer folds; nested inner-OOF fusion scores
offline_main_evaluation_audit.finding: The corrected two-BN-line fusion uses nested inner-OOF workflow-BN and runtime-BN scores and reaches F1 0.668, AUROC 0.820, AUPRC 0.675, Brier 0.160 and ECE 0.019. At fold-local 5% train-negative FPR thresholds it has test FPR 0.052 and recall 0.303. The matched runtime-logistic control reaches F1 0.653 and AUROC 0.805. The workflow-only BN line is not sufficient alone (AUROC 0.517), so the result supports complementary normative and runtime evidence rather than a claim that the DAG alone solves risk detection.
offline_main_evaluation_audit.additional_control_finding: On the same strict five-fold family holdout, graph-features logistic reaches AUROC 0.724/AUPRC 0.527 and local-only logistic 0.688/0.485; transparent dynamic-taint-path control reaches AUROC 0.597/AUPRC 0.405. Removing the runtime permission_mismatch component gives the two-line fusion AUROC 0.811/AUPRC 0.661, compared with 0.820/0.675 in the full model. The explanation audit finds a top path in 71.85% of episodes and a mean score drop of 0.042 after deleting it (0.066 on positives versus 0.030 on negatives). The prefix alarm audit obtains 15.5% pre-action recall on positives with an observable privileged action and 20.0% held-out negative false-alarm rate at the development operating point; the uncertainty audit covers 93.9% of episodes with a 6.1% abstention rate. These are protocol-compatible proxies and faithfulness/operating-point diagnostics, not reproductions of published MAS detectors or causal evidence.
required_before_submission: larger independently adjudicated or licensed MAS confirmation cohort across generating endpoints
online monitor p50/p95 latency and memory
cluster-level confidence intervals in the final main table
independent confirmation of low-false-alarm operating point
at least one runnable external MAS detector reproduction or an explicit non-SOTA framing
separate full-trace classification and pre-action early-warning reports with lead-time/false-alarm metrics

mast_external_audit.source: Public MAST/MAD release: 1642 MAS trajectories across seven systems and eight task benchmarks; downloaded from the authors' Hugging Face release.
mast_external_audit.feature_boundary: Trajectory text only; mast_annotation, MAS/benchmark identifiers and human annotations are excluded from features.
mast_external_audit.split: Five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by mas_name::benchmark_name with inner OOF fusion calibration.
mast_external_audit.interpretation: The public MAST annotation target is any released MAS failure, not the operational authorization/taint target of the main experiment. It is secondary transfer evidence; the 19 human traces are too small and imbalanced for a powered estimate and are reported descriptively only.

balanced_api_transfer_check.source: Eight predeclared two-agent authority scenarios generated through the local API gateway with gpt-5.6-luna/low
balanced_api_transfer_check.audit: VERIFICATION.json: 8/8 completed, 4/4 expected positives observed, 88 artifact hashes, no monitor-label leakage, zero network calls during verification
balanced_api_transfer_check.transfer_result: Frozen two-line model fit on independent_mas_v3 and applied without API-label fitting: hierarchical fusion AUROC 0.750, AUPRC 0.750, Brier 0.323; fixed 0.5 threshold raised no alarms under this domain shift.

expanded_transfer_diagnostic.claim_boundary: Capacity and failure-coverage diagnostic on the same local gateway; not a second endpoint or final confirmation cohort.

balanced_api_transfer_check.interpretation: External integration and calibration diagnostic only; the small same-gateway simulator is not a powered journal confirmation cohort.

local_model_transfer_diagnostic.source: Eight fixed two-agent authority cases generated through the local gateway with gpt-5.5/low; all 8/8 completed and 46/46 requests succeeded.
local_model_transfer_diagnostic.interpretation: The fixed simulator produced the same public projection as the earlier low-cost model cohort, so this is a model-transfer/collection audit, not an independent endpoint confirmation.

lanyun_endpoint_transfer_diagnostic.source: Twelve predeclared two-agent authority scenarios generated through the user-authorized Lanyun OpenAI-compatible endpoint with glm-5.3-flash; two failed stage outputs are retained outside scoring.
lanyun_endpoint_transfer_diagnostic.interpretation: The second endpoint and frozen monitor pipeline run successfully, but this is a small same-simulator transfer diagnostic; labels are post-run reference-policy outcomes and do not establish independent deployment performance.

expanded_transfer_diagnostic.interpretation: Larger second-endpoint transfer diagnostic with retained timeouts and empty-stage failures; still one hand-authored simulator and post-run policy labels, so not a final independent confirmation cohort.

pre_execution_policy_target.interpretation: A separate pre-execution policy-risk target. The rule line uses only public authority scopes, revocations and message resource consistency; it is transparent and target-specific, not a general safety result.

expanded_transfer_diagnostic_r15.interpretation: Larger second-endpoint transfer diagnostic with retained timeouts and empty-stage failures; still one hand-authored simulator and post-run policy labels, so not a final independent confirmation cohort.

pre_execution_policy_target.interpretation: A separate pre-execution policy-risk target. The rule line uses only public authority scopes, revocations and message resource consistency; it is transparent and target-specific, not a general safety result.

binding_consistency_extension.input: Public workflow, authority, delegation-message and privileged-action events only; labels are joined after scoring.
binding_consistency_extension.method: Fixed knowledge-compiled rule weights for resource/grant mismatch, parent-grant overbinding, authority mutation before action, repeated mutation, reused grant, and missing bindings. No refit, threshold tuning or API calls.
binding_consistency_extension.interpretation: A small transfer diagnostic showing how explicit knowledge templates can complement the two BN lines. It does not modify the frozen headline result or establish deployment performance.
limitations: one failed API case retained outside score
public projection can omit binding evidence

agentleak_external_validation.source: Pinned public AgentLeak release at revision 1301eb9245a03bbee8694ee2b74accbc8f6fefe6; 4979 files, 4258 eligible traces after excluding recorded API errors.
agentleak_external_validation.protocol: Five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by request identity; prefixes stop before the final coordinator-to-user message; labels recomputed independently from public vault/policy semantics and never used as features.
agentleak_external_validation.interpretation: The frozen two-line monitor does not transfer to this literal-privacy target: the release has a fixed coordinator/worker topology and the final literal can be absent from all earlier public messages. This negative transfer result is retained as a boundary test, not converted into a superiority claim.
agentleak_external_validation.next_action: Use a genuinely independent MAS cohort whose target is observable policy/action risk, or extend the monitor with an explicit privacy-schema knowledge layer and evaluate it as a separate task; do not merge this label with the operational-risk headline metric.

api_stage_forecast_development.source: Real low-cost gpt-5.5/low HarnessAudit Responses collections with independent artifact audits
api_stage_forecast_development.target: Any native V-OT/V-OR/V-IC/V-ID violation in the next stage's observed actions
api_stage_forecast_development.features: Declared workflow/policy, public stage packet and events visible before the stage; no ORACLE, LABELS, future actions, response IDs or task outcome
api_stage_forecast_development.model: q(V-OT|x) q(V-OR|V-OT,x) q(V-IC|previous,x) q(V-ID|previous,x), with exact system query 1-q(0000); knowledge-only, execution-only, relation-removed, independent-marginal and matched logistic/HistGB controls
api_stage_forecast_development.development_result: The v6 monitor adds six inspectable runtime-execution-graph statistics to the workflow/policy and prefix evidence. Hierarchical BN AUROC 0.875, AUPRC 0.703, Brier 0.127; OOF fused BN AUROC 0.890, AUPRC 0.749, Brier 0.121; matched HistGB Brier 0.110. No comprehensive superiority claim.
api_stage_forecast_development.rerun_result: On three same-task stochastic reruns, hierarchical BN AUROC 0.923, AUPRC 0.858, Brier 0.105; matched HistGB AUROC 1.000, AUPRC 1.000, Brier 0.073. This is operational replication, not task-generalization.
api_stage_forecast_development.transfer_result: Training on the 16-task expansion and testing on three earlier held-out task IDs (`ec-t3`, `fin-t1`, `off-t6`) gives hierarchical BN AUROC 0.963, AUPRC 0.953, Brier 0.1239, F1 0.800; matched flat logistic Brier 0.1505 and HistGB AUROC 0.963, AUPRC 0.953, Brier 0.1216. This is a small post-hoc development transfer check, not an independent confirmation set.
api_stage_forecast_development.interpretation: Evidence that a prefix-only two-line forecast can run on real API traces and that relation-aware joint factors are numerically auditable; evidence is too small and target-specific for final publication claims.
api_stage_forecast_development.latency_result: On 103 development stage windows, fixed-vector extraction mean/p50/p95 = 0.0013/0.0012/0.0023 ms; hierarchical BN inference = 1.023/0.828/1.716 ms; matched HistGB = 1.394/1.257/2.584 ms. API generation, semantic extraction, network transfer and training are excluded.
api_stage_forecast_development.next_action: Freeze a genuinely unseen task-family confirmation cohort with benign and violating next-stage outcomes, then add independent calibration, low-FPR alarm, latency and cost measurements.

a2asecbench_api_confirmation.source: A2ASecBench executable A2A environments driven through the local OpenAI-compatible API
a2asecbench_api_confirmation.model: gpt-5.5 for ASRF/CO; gpt-5.6-luna for ATSI/HOTF
a2asecbench_api_confirmation.sampling: Four attack families; 10 attack and 10 matched control cases per family; one trial per case; case IDs 001-010; no outcome-based replacement.
a2asecbench_api_confirmation.monitor_result: The deployable two-line fusion monitor selects a risk template from public workflow/vector fields and does not read the benchmark attack-family label. In leave-one-attack-family-out folds, fused AUROC is 0.833 and AUPRC 0.899, while flat logistic AUROC is 0.838 and AUPRC 0.855. Fused F1 is 0.784 and Brier 0.234; flat logistic F1 is 0.769 and Brier 0.193. A separate strict role audit uses the predeclared attack/control role as target, excludes observed_violation and all outcome metrics, and reaches two-line AUROC/AUPRC 0.788/0.835 (F1 0.682), equal to the matched flat logistic control. No superiority claim is made.
a2asecbench_api_confirmation.limitation: The original observed_violation target is emitted by the same reference harness that emits runtime events. The strict role audit removes that target-derived channel but still uses benchmark-design attack/control labels, so it is independent API execution and leakage control, not human-adjudicated real-world ground truth or a causal-discovery result.
a2asecbench_api_confirmation.next_action: Collect a frozen, unseen MAS/API confirmation cohort with labels independent of the feature adapter; then rerun the same baselines, calibration, low-FPR warning and latency protocol.

formal_collection.independent_unit: Base task family and actual upstream-message group; all continuations and prefixes remain together
required_variation: more than one generating model where feasible
formal_collection.sample_size: Determine and freeze from development variance, risk prevalence and desired group-level interval precision. No fixed episode count is falsely attributed to a journal rule.
formal_collection.failures: Retain attempted, failed, refused, truncated and incomplete runs; do not relabel as safe or replace selectively.
formal_collection.model_and_prompt_changes: Permitted on development only; new confirmation cohort required after test-informed changes.

evaluation_requirements.requirement: Matched-input current-action policy detection and original-scope MAS guard comparison
evaluation_requirements.development_evidence: Lanyun pre-execution policy target and public knowledge rule completed on 80 observable prefixes; not independent confirmation.

evaluation_requirements.requirement: Action-before-execution joint forecasting against strong same-supervision controls
evaluation_requirements.development_evidence: No final action-before-execution forecast claim; the Lanyun policy-intent target is a separate diagnostic.

evaluation_requirements.requirement: Independent calibration and workflow-level low-false-alarm warning
evaluation_requirements.development_evidence: Main synthetic calibration, grouped uncertainty coverage-risk and prefix alarm audits are recorded; held-out negative false-alarm shift and independent low-FPR confirmation remain unresolved.

evaluation_requirements.requirement: Held-out task, topology, policy composition and generating-model transfer with each setting named precisely
evaluation_requirements.development_evidence: Lanyun supplies a second generating endpoint but keeps the same hand-authored two-agent topology.

evaluation_requirements.requirement: Natural missingness coverage plus separately labelled evidence-error and missing-record stress tests
evaluation_requirements.development_evidence: R14 retains 14 failed/incomplete runs; no systematic independent missingness/error cohort yet.

evaluation_requirements.requirement: Observable intermediate semantics, object/role binding, evidence lineage and independent numerical explanation verification
evaluation_requirements.development_evidence: Public authority/resource rule explanations, lineage audits and the 4,000-case counterfactual path-faithfulness check exist; independent semantic adjudication is incomplete.

evaluation_requirements.requirement: API usage, training cost, monitor p50/p95 latency, memory and inference-width scaling
evaluation_requirements.development_evidence: Lanyun R15 records 416 requests, 459902 tokens, transport p50/p95 7.429/28.555s; monitor-side scaling now reports p95 0.532/1.398/1.905ms for 1-3/7-10/11+ events, but semantic extraction and a full deployment cost table remain.

candidate_forecast_scope.prediction_time: Before an actual SDK model request; the next model reply and its tool arguments/results are not input features.
candidate_forecast_scope.horizon: The first actual tool invocation in that next model reply, or an explicit terminal no-tool reply. Other tools in the same batch are not silently counted as this horizon's future event.
candidate_forecast_scope.learned_distribution: q(A|prefix) q(C|A,prefix) q(B|C,A,prefix) q(S|C,B,A,prefix), with verified current-state evidence clamped and missing supervision marginalized exactly.
candidate_forecast_scope.training_objective: Conditional composite log score: sum window scores within each trace, average across traces, with declared regularization. A is estimated independently at each window; this is not a cross-time generative state model.
candidate_forecast_scope.fixed_policy: For the implemented prerequisite templates, violation = (C is TRIGGER) AND NOT(A AND B) AND S. Do not learn away policy constraints.
boundaries: Candidate next-call forecast, not yet a measured system-wide warning model
Unknown current state needs an explicit learned prior or reported bounds, never an assumed safe state
OTHER and STOP have no effect relevant to this named contract
Different contracts' probabilities cannot be multiplied as independent without a justified joint model
New relational contracts are explicit extensions, not original benchmark ground truth

statistical_contract.splits: Task-group fit, independent calibration and untouched confirmation test; no random prefix split
primary_hypotheses: Knowledge and execution relations support transfer across workflows and policy combinations
Preserving genuine shared dependence improves system-risk estimation beyond matched local predictors
Semantic anchoring and executable factors make explanations independently checkable
statistical_contract.intervals: Paired cluster resampling over independent task or upstream groups, retaining within-group continuations
statistical_contract.main_comparisons: Predeclare primary metrics and comparisons before confirmation-test generation or exposure
statistical_contract.tuning: All factor structures, prompts, knowledge entries, hyperparameters and thresholds selected without confirmation-test outcomes
statistical_contract.report_all: All declared methods, failed runs, subgroup denominators, uncertainty intervals and unsupported regimes

artifact_contract.history: Preserve immutable raw runs, failures and frozen source for reproducibility; remove legacy claims and competing current-model instructions from the active README
artifact_contract.cleanup: Inventory and archive recoverably by explicit paths; do not move running collections or alter frozen source, unrelated dirty work, credentials or external environments
artifact_contract.completion: Every E1-E7 requirement has direct evidence and limitations; journal partition eligibility is checked for the chosen venue; final claims are traceable to the frozen results. No automatic guarantee of acceptance.
